.DISCUSSION...

KEY MESSAGE 1...Warmer Sunday with widespread showers and possible
 thunderstorms. Sharp cold front crosses the area Sunday night.

KEY MESSAGE 1 DESCRIPTION...

Showers are on their way out this afternoon with clearing
expected tonight. Cold front will cross the area Sunday evening
with models depicting anafrontal structure with numerous to
widespread showers expected Sunday afternoon into Monday morning.
A slight risk of thunderstorms is also possible, but the threat
of severe wx remains low. Drying is expected late Monday morning
as cdfnt pushes further to the south. 


KEY MESSAGE 2... Late-season frost/freeze expected Monday night west 
of the Blue Ridge, followed by moderating temperatures and returning 
rain chances.

KEY MESSAGE 2 DESCRIPTION...

High pressure builds overhead Mon night. Winds go light/calm 
resulting in favorable conditions for radiational cooling. This will 
result in light winds and favorable radiational cooling conditions. 
Frost or near freezing temps could result in the sheltered valleys 
near and west of I-81. This could be rather impactful given the fact 
that we are approaching mid-May at this point which is a couple 
weeks to a month past the median last freeze for these areas.

Return flow returns Tue with high moving offshore. The warming trend 
will be more noticeable heading into Wed as a warm front lifts into 
the region, followed by a cold front and wave of low pressure Wed 
night into Thu. This frontal system will bring a chance of showers 
and a few thunderstorms mid week, with guidance split on exactly how 
much rain falls over the area. Rain forecast to be beneficial in 
nature given ongoing drought.

Temps will actually trend warmer in the wake of the frontal system 
at the end of next week as large scale height rises commence.

&&

.AVIATION /19Z SATURDAY THROUGH THURSDAY/...

Isolated showers this afternoon. Numerous to widespread showers
and possible thunderstorms Sunday afternoon and evening with
possible flight restrictions. Dry Monday afternoon through mid-
week.

&&

.MARINE...

Winds have dropped below SCA and a downward trend is expected
through tonight, so canceled SCA early. Winds will remain below
10 kt through Sunday befor picking up again Sunday night with a
frontal passage. New SCAs will be needed for Sunday night
through much of the new work week.
